summary: Verified the two NEW features (dark mode + PDF export) and light regression. All checks passed: theme-toggle-button toggles `dark` class on <html>, persists in localStorage key 'studymate-theme' across reload; Dashboard PDF export triggers a real download named 'studymate-*.pdf' with 'PDF downloaded' toast and no JS errors; Detail view (History → Open) also downloads a valid studymate-*.pdf and shows the success toast. Dashboard generate + history + detail regression flow still works.
critical_code_review_comments: useTheme.js reads initial theme from document.documentElement class (set by inline snippet in App.js). This is fine but means the hook does not itself read localStorage on mount — it relies on App.js pre-hydration snippet. Acceptable, but slightly implicit. Consider reading localStorage inside getInitialTheme for robustness.

exportPdf.js uses inline unicode check mark (✓) in helvetica which jsPDF may render as a missing glyph in some environments. Not observed as a visible error in this test, but if it appears as '?' or a box in generated quiz PDFs, consider using [x] instead of [✓].

History.jsx: the whole history-item-card is styled like it's clickable but requires the explicit 'Open' button to navigate — minor UX inconsistency (card cursor/hover suggests clickability). Not a blocker.
seed_data_creation: None; generated one new Summary during test which was auto-persisted (history had prior items).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 1 covered 12 core flows. Iteration 2 covered: (a) theme toggle add/remove of `dark` on <html>, localStorage 'studymate-theme' persistence across reload, dark-mode visual integrity on Dashboard (body bg rgb(22,26,34), textarea readable, no residual white cards); (b) PDF export on Dashboard after generating summary — download event fired with filename studymate-summary-*.pdf and toast 'PDF downloaded'; (c) PDF export on GenerationDetail via history-item-open-button — same successful download + toast. Note: history cards are opened via [data-testid=history-item-open-button] (card root does not navigate on click).
